a.text: I want to be upfront before we start. With an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to reach 8 first almost certainly gets us both killed: after round 1 the reserve would be 6, and a storm would end the episode with both of us empty. The reserve holds exactly 4 now, so only one of us can be safe after round 1. I intend to take 4 in round 1. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than doing it quietly. If we both take, the random split could leave us both short, so please weigh that. If we both get through, I'll operate with you every round afterward and give cells back if it helps you reach 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I'm sorry it breaks our deal. If we're still going next round, I'll operate every round with you so the reserve can rebuild to 4 for you, and I won't take any more.
